mcqs.question: Who became the longest-serving elected head of government in India, with 8,931 days in office, surpassing Pawan Kumar Chamling?
options: Narendra Modi
Pawan Kumar Chamling
José Antonio Kast
Balen Shah
mcqs.explanation: Narendra Modi became India’s longest-serving elected head of government with 8,931 days, surpassing Pawan Kumar Chamling’s 8,930 days. José Antonio Kast and Balen Shah were in news for leadership changes in Chile and Nepal, respectively.

mcqs.keyword: First woman nuclear power station superintendent
mcqs.question: Which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: R.M. Nachammai was the first woman Chief Superintendent of an Indian nuclear power station.
R.M. Nachammai served at Kaiga in Karnataka.
Saba Shah became the first Kashmiri woman Superintendent of Central Jail Srinagar.
R.M. Nachammai served at Kaiga in Tamil Nadu.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement places Kaiga in Tamil Nadu; the nuclear power station is in Karnataka. R.M. Nachammai was the first woman Chief Superintendent of an Indian nuclear power station, while Saba Shah was the first Kashmiri woman Superintendent of Central Jail Srinagar.

mcqs.question: Who won the Best Actor award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026?
options: Michael B. Jordan for “Sinners”
Jessie Buckley for “Hamnet”
Amy Madigan for “Weapons”
Ryan Coogler
mcqs.explanation: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for “Sinners” at the 98th Academy Awards. Jessie Buckley won Best Actress, Amy Madigan won Best Supporting Actress, and Ryan Coogler won Original Screenplay.

mcqs.question:
With reference to the 98th Academy Awards in 2026, consider the following statements:
1. “One Battle After Another” won six awards.
2. “Sinners” won four awards.
3. “Sentimental Value” won the Animated Feature award.
options: 1 and 2 only
2 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: “One Battle After Another” won six awards and “Sinners” won four. Statement 3 is incorrect because “K-Pop Demon Hunters” won Animated Feature, while “Sentimental Value” won International Feature.

mcqs.question: Who won the Pritzker Architecture Prize 2026?
options: Smiljan Radic Clarke
Philip Johnson
Zaha Hadid
Balkrishna Doshi
mcqs.explanation: Smiljan Radic Clarke of Chile won the Pritzker Architecture Prize 2026. Philip Johnson was the first winner, Zaha Hadid was the first woman winner, and Balkrishna Doshi was the first Indian winner.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes the recipient of the Saraswati Samman 2025?
options: It recognised the Bengali novel “Hara Parbati Katha” by Ramkumar Mukhopadhyay.
It recognised the Bengali novel “Hara Parbati Katha” by the K.K. Birla Foundation.
It carried a prize amount of ₹15 crore.
It was restricted to works published in the last 10 months.
mcqs.explanation: The Saraswati Samman 2025 recognised the Bengali novel “Hara Parbati Katha” by Ramkumar Mukhopadhyay. The award was instituted by the K.K. Birla Foundation, carries ₹15 lakh, and considers works published in the last 10 years.

mcqs.question: When and where is the Sangeetha Kalanidhi 2026 honour for Jayanthi Kumaresh scheduled to be presented?
options: At the 100th Annual Conference of Music Academy, Chennai, on 1 January 2027
At the 100th Annual Conference of Music Academy, Chennai, on 1 January 2026
At the 100th Annual Conference of Music Academy, Hyderabad, on 1 January 2027
At the 98th Annual Conference of Music Academy, Chennai, on 1 January 2027
mcqs.explanation: Jayanthi Kumaresh is to receive the honour at the 100th Annual Conference of Music Academy in Chennai on 1 January 2027. She is a veena exponent and the first veena artist in nearly three decades to receive the honour.

mcqs.question: Which honour was conferred on former ambassador Javed Ashraf by France on 18 March 2026?
options: Commander of the Legion of Honour
KBE of the Order of the British Empire
University of Chicago Alumni Award
Sangeetha Kalanidhi
mcqs.explanation: Javed Ashraf received the Commander rank of France’s Legion of Honour on 18 March 2026. KBE was conferred on N. Chandrasekaran, while K.V. Subramanian received the University of Chicago Alumni Award.

mcqs.question:
Assertion (A): K.V. Subramanian became the first Indian economist since 1941 to receive the University of Chicago Alumni Award.
Reason (R): He was a former Chief Economic Adviser from 2018–21 and a former IMF Managing Director.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
mcqs.explanation: Assertion A is true: K.V. Subramanian was the first Indian economist since 1941 to receive the University of Chicago Alumni Award. Reason R is false because he was a former IMF Executive Director, not a former IMF Managing Director.
